intro.en: Your Main Book. Learn one chapter at a time with Roy. Every new word is explained first.
intro.zh: 你的主课本。和 Roy 老师一章一章地学。每个新词都先解释。

title.en: Part A: Atoms, Elements, Compounds and Mixtures
title.zh: A 部分：原子、元素、化合物和混合物

title.en: Part B: Light, Sound and the Electromagnetic Spectrum
title.zh: B 部分：光、声音和电磁波谱

title.en: Everything is made of tiny particles
title.zh: 所有东西都由很小的粒子组成

points.en: A particle is a very, very tiny piece of something. Too small to see, even with a normal microscope.
points.zh: 粒子是非常非常小的一块东西，小到连普通显微镜都看不见。

points.en: Your desk, the air, water, and even you are all made of particles.
points.zh: 你的桌子、空气、水，甚至你自己，都是由粒子组成的。

remember.en: particle 粒子 = a very tiny piece
remember.zh: particle 粒子 = 非常小的一块

points.en: An atom is the smallest particle of an element. (We learn "element" on the next page.)
points.zh: 原子是元素的最小粒子。（下一页学“元素”。）

points.en: Think of an atom as one LEGO brick. In pictures, we draw one atom as one circle.
points.zh: 把原子想成一块乐高积木。在图里，一个原子画成一个圆圈。

label.en: six atoms of the same kind

remember.zh: 原子 = 最小的粒子 = 一个圆圈

points.en: An element is a substance made of only ONE type of atom. A substance just means "a kind of stuff".
points.zh: 元素是只由一种原子组成的物质。物质的意思就是“一种东西”。

points.en: Gold is an element: only gold atoms. Oxygen is an element: only oxygen atoms.
points.zh: 金是元素：只有金原子。氧是元素：只有氧原子。

remember.en: element = only ONE type of atom
remember.zh: 元素 = 只有一种原子

quick.q: A substance made of only ONE type of atom is...

why.en: One type of atom = element.
why.zh: 只有一种原子 = 元素。

title.en: The periodic table 元素周期表

points.en: The periodic table is a big chart that lists ALL the elements. There are about 118.
points.zh: 元素周期表是一张列出所有元素的大表，大约有 118 种。

points.en: Each element has a symbol: 1 or 2 letters. The first letter is always a CAPITAL.
points.zh: 每种元素有一个符号：1 或 2 个字母。第一个字母永远大写。

title.en: Metals 金属 and non-metals 非金属

points.en: Metals: usually shiny, hard, and let heat and electricity pass through. Examples: iron, copper, gold, magnesium.
points.zh: 金属：通常有光泽、很硬，能导热导电。例子：铁、铜、金、镁。

points.en: Non-metals: usually dull, and many are gases. Examples: oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, carbon.
points.zh: 非金属：通常没有光泽，很多是气体。例子：氧、氮、硫、碳。

points.en: MOST elements are metals.
points.zh: 大部分元素是金属。

items.zh: 非金属：常是气体或没光泽

points.en: Magnetic means a magnet can pull it.
points.zh: 有磁性的意思是磁铁能吸住它。

points.en: Only a FEW metals are magnetic: iron, nickel and cobalt. Most metals are NOT magnetic.
points.zh: 只有少数金属有磁性：铁、镍、钴。大部分金属没有磁性。

quick.q: Which metal is magnetic?

why.en: Only iron, nickel and cobalt are magnetic. Copper is not.
why.zh: 只有铁、镍、钴有磁性，铜没有。

points.en: Room temperature means the normal temperature inside a room, about 20 °C.
points.zh: 室温就是房间里平常的温度，大约 20 °C。

points.en: At room temperature, only TWO elements are liquid: mercury and bromine. Most elements are solid.
points.zh: 在室温下，只有两种元素是液体：汞和溴。大部分元素是固体。

remember.en: Only 2 liquid elements: mercury and bromine.
remember.zh: 只有 2 种液态元素：汞和溴。

points.en: A molecule is 2 or more atoms chemically joined together.
points.zh: 分子是 2 个或更多原子化学结合在一起。

points.en: Chemically joined means stuck together by a strong link called a bond. In pictures, the circles TOUCH.
points.zh: 化学结合的意思是用一种叫“化学键”的牢固连接粘在一起。在图里，圆圈是碰在一起的。

points.en: Oxygen in the air is O₂: two oxygen atoms joined. Both atoms are the same, so it is still an ELEMENT.
points.zh: 空气里的氧是 O₂：两个氧原子结合。两个原子一样，所以还是元素。

points.en: Same for H₂ (hydrogen) and N₂ (nitrogen). They are elements AND molecules.
points.zh: H₂（氢）和 N₂（氮）也一样。它们既是元素，也是分子。

remember.en: Same colour joined = still an element.
remember.zh: 相同颜色结合 = 还是元素。

quick.q: O₂ is...

why.en: Both atoms are oxygen, so it is still an element.
why.zh: 两个原子都是氧，所以还是元素。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A1.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A1 的关键词。

points.en: A pure substance has only ONE kind of particle all the way through.
points.zh: 纯净物从头到尾只有一种粒子。

points.en: Elements are pure. Compounds are pure too (next page). Mixtures are NOT pure.
points.zh: 元素是纯净物，化合物也是纯净物（下一页）。混合物不是纯净物。

points.en: A compound is 2 or more DIFFERENT types of atom chemically joined.
points.zh: 化合物是 2 种或更多不同的原子化学结合在一起。

points.en: Water (H₂O): hydrogen and oxygen joined. Carbon dioxide (CO₂): carbon and oxygen joined.
points.zh: 水 (H₂O)：氢和氧结合。二氧化碳 (CO₂)：碳和氧结合。

remember.zh: 不同颜色结合 = 化合物。

title.en: A compound is a NEW substance

points.en: A compound is very different from the elements it is made from.
points.zh: 化合物和组成它的元素非常不一样。

points.en: Sodium (a soft shiny metal) + chlorine (a poisonous green gas) = sodium chloride, the salt we eat!
points.zh: 钠（软软的亮金属）+ 氯（有毒的绿色气体）= 氯化钠，就是我们吃的盐！

points.en: A mixture is 2 or more substances mixed together but NOT chemically joined.
points.zh: 混合物是 2 种或更多物质混在一起，但没有化学结合。

points.en: Like a fruit salad: each fruit is still there and you can pick it out.
points.zh: 像水果沙拉：每种水果还在，可以挑出来。

quick.q: Sand and water stirred together is a...

why.en: Not chemically joined, so a mixture.
why.zh: 没有化学结合，所以是混合物。

points.en: Separate means pull apart. Mixtures can be separated because they are not joined.
points.zh: 分离就是分开。混合物能分离，因为它们没有结合。

points.en: Ways to separate: a magnet (for iron), a filter (for sand and water), evaporating (for salt water).
points.zh: 分离方法：磁铁（分出铁）、过滤（分开沙和水）、蒸发（从盐水里得到盐）。

points.en: An alloy is a mixture of metals (melted and mixed).
points.zh: 合金是几种金属熔化后混在一起。

points.en: Brass = copper + zinc. It is a MIXTURE, not a compound, because the metals are not chemically joined.
points.zh: 黄铜 = 铜 + 锌。它是混合物，不是化合物，因为金属没有化学结合。

quick.q: Brass (copper + zinc) is...

why.en: An alloy is a mixture of metals.
why.zh: 合金是金属的混合物。

points.en: Mixtures: air, sea water, petrol, brass.
points.zh: 混合物：空气、海水、汽油、黄铜。

points.en: Compounds: water, salt (sodium chloride), carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, copper sulfate.
points.zh: 化合物：水、盐（氯化钠）、二氧化碳、一氧化碳、硫酸铜。

points.en: Elements: oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen, magnesium, sulfur, bromine, iron.
points.zh: 元素：氧、氢、氮、镁、硫、溴、铁。

title.en: Formula 化学式 and the capital-letter clue
title.zh: 化学式和大写字母线索

points.en: A formula shows which atoms are in ONE particle, using symbols. H₂O = 2 hydrogen atoms + 1 oxygen atom.
points.zh: 化学式用符号表示一个粒子里有哪些原子。H₂O = 2 个氢原子 + 1 个氧原子。

points.en: Count the CAPITAL letters: 1 capital = element (O₂, N₂, Mg). 2 or more = compound (NaCl, CO₂).
points.zh: 数大写字母：1 个 = 元素（O₂、N₂、Mg）；2 个或以上 = 化合物（NaCl、CO₂）。

points.en: Careful: Co (small o) is cobalt, an element. CO (capital O) is carbon monoxide, a compound.
points.zh: 注意：Co（小写 o）是钴，元素。CO（大写 O）是一氧化碳，化合物。

main.en: 1 capital = element.  2+ capitals = compound.
main.zh: 1 个大写 = 元素。2 个以上 = 化合物。

quick.q: Co (small o) is...

why.en: One capital letter = one element: cobalt.
why.zh: 一个大写字母 = 一种元素：钴。

points.en: Ask these every time.
points.zh: 每次都问这三个问题。

steps.en: One type of atom only? → element
steps.zh: 只有一种原子？→ 元素
不同原子结合？→ 化合物

steps.en: Not joined, can be separated? → mixture
steps.zh: 没有结合，可以分开？→ 混合物

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A2.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A2 的关键词。

title.en: What is a particle diagram? 粒子图

points.en: A particle diagram is a box that shows the particles inside a substance.
points.zh: 粒子图是一个方框，画出物质里面的粒子。

points.en: 1 circle = 1 atom. Touching circles = joined (a molecule). Different colours = different kinds of atom.
points.zh: 1 个圆圈 = 1 个原子。碰在一起 = 结合（分子）。颜色不同 = 原子种类不同。

title.en: Step 1: how many KINDS of particle?

points.en: Look at the whole box. Are all the particles the same?
points.zh: 看整个方框。所有粒子都一样吗？

points.en: One kind = pure substance. Two or more kinds = mixture.
points.zh: 一种 = 纯净物。两种或以上 = 混合物。

title.zh: 第二步：看一个粒子里面

points.en: Same colour atoms = element. Different colours joined = compound.
points.zh: 颜色相同的原子 = 元素。不同颜色结合 = 化合物。

quick.q: Particles made of different coloured atoms joined, all the same: this is...

why.en: One kind of particle with different atoms joined = compound.
why.zh: 只有一种粒子，里面是不同原子结合 = 化合物。

points.en: Single atoms, all the same: element (single atoms), e.g. magnesium.
points.zh: 单个原子，全部一样：元素（单个原子），比如镁。

points.en: Pairs of the same atoms: element (molecules), e.g. oxygen O₂.
points.zh: 相同原子成对：元素（分子），比如氧 O₂。

points.en: Every particle is the same, and each one has different atoms joined.
points.zh: 每个粒子都一样，每个里面都是不同原子结合。

title.zh: 方框 4：两种元素的混合物

points.en: Two kinds of particle, and each kind has only one colour.
points.zh: 两种粒子，每种只有一种颜色。

title.zh: 方框 5：两种化合物的混合物

points.en: Two kinds of particle, and each kind has different colours joined.
points.zh: 两种粒子，每种都是不同颜色结合。

title.en: Box 6: mixture of an element and a compound
title.zh: 方框 6：元素和化合物的混合物

points.en: One kind is one colour (element). The other kind is different colours joined (compound).
points.zh: 一种粒子只有一种颜色（元素），另一种是不同颜色结合（化合物）。

label.en: mixture of an element and a compound
label.zh: 元素和化合物的混合物

points.en: "Mixture" alone is not enough. Say WHAT is mixed: two elements? two compounds? an element and a compound?
points.zh: 只写 mixture 不够。要说明是什么混在一起：两种元素？两种化合物？元素和化合物？

points.en: "Molecules" alone is not enough. Write "element (molecules)".
points.zh: 只写 molecules 不够。要写 element (molecules)。

label.en: mixture of an element and a compound
label.zh: 元素和化合物的混合物

quick.q: Two kinds of particle, each only one colour: write...

why.en: Always write the FULL name.
why.zh: 一定要写完整的名称。

points.en: "Draw THREE water molecules" means 3 groups, each 1 oxygen joined to 2 hydrogen. That is 9 atoms.
points.zh: “画三个水分子”就是画 3 组，每组 1 个氧连着 2 个氢，一共 9 个原子。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A3.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A3 的关键词。

points.en: A symbol is a short name for an element: 1 or 2 letters, first letter CAPITAL, second letter small.
points.zh: 符号是元素的简称：1 或 2 个字母，第一个大写，第二个小写。

points.en: Some come from Latin: Na (sodium), K (potassium), Fe (iron), Cu (copper), Pb (lead).
points.zh: 有些来自拉丁文：Na（钠）、K（钾）、Fe（铁）、Cu（铜）、Pb（铅）。

points.en: The small number belongs to the symbol BEFORE it. It tells how many of that atom.
points.zh: 小数字属于它前面的符号，表示那种原子有几个。

points.en: No small number = 1 atom. CO₂ = 1 carbon + 2 oxygen.
points.zh: 没有小数字 = 1 个原子。CO₂ = 1 个碳 + 2 个氧。

main.en: H₂O = H H O
main.zh: H₂O = H H O

example.zh: 2 个氢 + 1 个氧 = 3 个原子

points.en: Add the numbers: CH₄ = 1 + 4 = 5. C₃H₈ = 3 + 8 = 11. H₂SO₄ = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7.
points.zh: 把数字加起来：CH₄ = 1 + 4 = 5。C₃H₈ = 3 + 8 = 11。H₂SO₄ = 2 + 1 + 4 = 7。

main.en: count = add all the small numbers (no number = 1)
main.zh: 原子数 = 所有小数字相加（没写 = 1）

quick.q: How many atoms are in ONE molecule of H₂O?

why.en: 2 hydrogen + 1 oxygen = 3 atoms.
why.zh: 2 个氢 + 1 个氧 = 3 个原子。

points.en: Number of molecules × atoms in ONE molecule. Write it ONCE, then stop.
points.zh: 分子个数 × 一个分子的原子数。只写一次，然后停。

points.en: 4 molecules of H₂O: 4 × 3 = 12 atoms.
points.zh: 4 个 H₂O 分子：4 × 3 = 12 个原子。

main.en: total = molecules × atoms in one
main.zh: 总数 = 分子数 × 一个分子的原子数

quick.q: How many hydrogen atoms are in 3H₂O?

why.en: 3 molecules × 2 hydrogen = 6.
why.zh: 3 个分子 × 2 个氢 = 6。

points.en: A ratio compares amounts. Follow the ORDER of the words in the question.
points.zh: 比是用来比较数量的。按题目里词的顺序写。

points.en: CO₂ carbon : oxygen = 1 : 2.  H₂O hydrogen : oxygen = 2 : 1.
points.zh: CO₂ 碳 : 氧 = 1 : 2。H₂O 氢 : 氧 = 2 : 1。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A4.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A4 的关键词。

title.zh: 文字方程式和化合物命名

points.en: In a chemical reaction, atoms unclick and click together in a NEW way. A new substance is made.
points.zh: 化学反应中，原子拆开再用新的方式结合，生成新物质。

points.en: Like LEGO: take bricks apart and build something new.
points.zh: 像乐高：把积木拆开，再搭成新东西。

title.en: Reactants 反应物 → products 生成物

points.en: Reactants are what you START with (left). Products are what is MADE (right). The arrow means "makes".
points.zh: 反应物是开始的东西（左边）。生成物是生成的东西（右边）。箭头表示“生成”。

main.en: reactants → products
main.zh: 反应物 → 生成物

quick.q: In magnesium + oxygen → magnesium oxide, the product is...

why.en: Products are on the RIGHT of the arrow.
why.zh: 生成物在箭头右边。

points.en: Keep the metal name. Change the end of the non-metal: oxygen → oxide, chlorine → chloride, sulfur → sulfide.
points.zh: 金属名不变。非金属改结尾：oxygen → oxide，chlorine → chloride，sulfur → sulfide。

points.en: Elements on the LEFT never end in -ide.
points.zh: 左边的元素名字永远不加 -ide。

points.en: Two non-metals use number words: carbon MONoxide CO (1 oxygen), carbon DIoxide CO₂ (2 oxygen), sulfur dioxide SO₂.
points.zh: 两个非金属用数字词：一氧化碳 CO（1 个氧）、二氧化碳 CO₂（2 个氧）、二氧化硫 SO₂。

points.en: -ate means oxygen is in it too: copper sulfate, calcium carbonate.
points.zh: -ate 表示里面还有氧：硫酸铜、碳酸钙。

quick.q: CO₂ is called carbon...

why.en: di = 2 oxygens.
why.zh: di = 2 个氧。

points.en: magnesium + oxygen → magnesium oxide
points.zh: 镁 + 氧 → 氧化镁

points.en: iron + sulfur → iron sulfide
points.zh: 铁 + 硫 → 硫化亚铁

points.en: sodium + chlorine → sodium chloride
points.zh: 钠 + 氯 → 氯化钠

points.en: calcium carbonate → calcium oxide + carbon dioxide
points.zh: 碳酸钙 → 氧化钙 + 二氧化碳

points.en: water → hydrogen + oxygen  (one compound → two elements)
points.zh: 水 → 氢 + 氧（一种化合物 → 两种元素）

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A5.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A5 的关键词。

points.en: Same substance, new look. Usually you can change it back.
points.zh: 物质不变，样子变了。通常可以变回去。

points.en: Examples: ice melting, water boiling, sugar dissolving in water.
points.zh: 例子：冰融化、水沸腾、糖溶在水里。

quick.q: Melting ice is a...

why.en: No new substance: it is still water.
why.zh: 没有新物质，还是水。

points.en: A NEW substance is made. Very hard to change back.
points.zh: 生成了新物质，很难变回去。

points.en: Examples: burning paper, rusting iron, cooking an egg, baking a cake.
points.zh: 例子：烧纸、铁生锈、煮鸡蛋、烤蛋糕。

points.en: Look for any of these:
points.zh: 看看有没有这些：

quick.q: Bubbles of a new gas appear. This is a sign of a...

why.en: A new substance (gas) is made.
why.zh: 产生了新物质（气体）。

points.en: Before heating: iron + sulfur is a MIXTURE. A magnet pulls the iron out.
points.zh: 加热前：铁 + 硫是混合物，磁铁能把铁吸出来。

points.en: Heat it: it glows (a sign of reaction). After: iron sulfide, a COMPOUND. The magnet can't pull the iron out.
points.zh: 加热：发光（反应的迹象）。之后：硫化亚铁，是化合物，磁铁吸不出铁。

title.en: Mass 质量 and conservation of mass 质量守恒

points.en: Mass = how much stuff something has. We measure it in grams (g).
points.zh: 质量 = 东西有多少，用克 (g) 来量。

points.en: Atoms are never lost or made. 2.0 g iron + 0.8 g sulfur = 2.8 g iron sulfide.
points.zh: 原子不会消失，也不会凭空出现。2.0 克铁 + 0.8 克硫 = 2.8 克硫化亚铁。

main.en: mass before = mass after
main.zh: 反应前质量 = 反应后质量

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A6.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A6 的关键词。

title.en: States of Matter, Melting and Boiling Points
title.zh: 物质的状态、熔点和沸点

title.en: Solid 固体, liquid 液体, gas 气体

points.en: Solid: particles touching in NEAT rows, only wiggle. Fixed shape.
points.zh: 固体：粒子紧挨着排成整齐的行，只能轻轻振动。形状固定。

points.en: Liquid: particles touching but RANDOM, they slide. Takes the shape of its container.
points.zh: 液体：粒子挨着但无序，会滑动。形状随容器变。

points.en: Gas: particles FAR apart, moving fast everywhere.
points.zh: 气体：粒子离得很远，到处快速运动。

remember.zh: 教室（固体）、走廊（液体）、操场（气体）。

points.en: Temperature tells how hot or cold something is. We measure it in degrees Celsius (°C).
points.zh: 温度表示东西有多热或多冷，单位是摄氏度 (°C)。

points.en: Water freezes at 0 °C. Colder than 0 is written with a minus: -10 °C is very cold.
points.zh: 水在 0 °C 结冰。比 0 冷的温度写负号：-10 °C 非常冷。

points.en: Melting 熔化: solid → liquid (ice → water).
points.zh: 熔化：固体 → 液体（冰 → 水）。

points.en: Boiling 沸腾 or evaporating 蒸发: liquid → gas (water → steam).
points.zh: 沸腾或蒸发：液体 → 气体（水 → 水蒸气）。

points.en: Condensing 凝结: gas → liquid (drops on a cold glass).
points.zh: 凝结：气体 → 液体（冷杯子外的水珠）。

points.en: Freezing 凝固: liquid → solid (water → ice).
points.zh: 凝固：液体 → 固体（水 → 冰）。

remember.en: Gas → liquid is condensing, NOT boiling.
remember.zh: 气体 → 液体是凝结，不是沸腾。

quick.q: Gas turning into liquid is called...

why.en: Cooling a gas turns it back to liquid: condensing.
why.zh: 气体冷却变回液体：凝结。

points.en: The melting point is the temperature where a solid turns into a liquid.
points.zh: 熔点是固体变成液体的温度。

points.en: Ice melts at 0 °C. Iron melts at 1540 °C. Mercury melts at -39 °C!
points.zh: 冰在 0 °C 熔化。铁在 1540 °C 熔化。汞在 -39 °C 就熔化了！

points.en: The boiling point is the temperature where a liquid turns into a gas.
points.zh: 沸点是液体变成气体的温度。

points.en: Water boils at 100 °C. Mercury boils at 357 °C.
points.zh: 水在 100 °C 沸腾。汞在 357 °C 沸腾。

title.en: Negative numbers on a number line

points.en: On a number line, numbers to the LEFT are smaller (colder). -100 < -39 < -5 < 0 < 12.
-39 is colder than 0. The bigger the number after the minus, the colder it is.
points.zh: -39 比 0 冷。负号后面的数越大，越冷。

title.en: Solid, liquid or gas? The rule
title.zh: 固体、液体还是气体？规则

points.en: Colder than the melting point = solid. Between melting and boiling point = liquid. Hotter than the boiling point = gas.
points.zh: 比熔点低 = 固体。在熔点和沸点之间 = 液体。比沸点高 = 气体。

points.en: Mercury at 0 °C: 0 is hotter than -39 but colder than 357, so it is between: LIQUID.
points.zh: 0 °C 时的汞：0 比 -39 热，但比 357 冷，所以在中间：液体。

points.en: Answer with the element's NAME (mercury), not "melting point".
points.zh: 答案写元素名字（mercury），不要写 melting point。

quick.q: Room temperature is 20 °C. Melting point 50 °C. At room temperature it is a...

why.en: 20 °C is below the melting point, so it has not melted: solid.
why.zh: 20 °C 低于熔点，还没熔化：固体。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A7.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A7 的关键词。

title.en: Investigation 实验 and fair test 公平测试

points.en: An investigation is a test to find an answer to a question.
points.zh: 实验是为了回答一个问题而做的测试。

points.en: A fair test changes only ONE thing, so we know what caused the result.
points.zh: 公平测试只改变一个因素，这样我们才知道结果是什么造成的。

points.en: Independent variable 自变量: the ONE thing I Change.
points.zh: 自变量：我改变的那一个因素。

points.en: Dependent variable 因变量: what I Measure.
points.zh: 因变量：我测量的东西。

points.en: Control variables 控制变量: what I keep the Same.
points.zh: 控制变量：我保持不变的东西。

quick.q: In a fair test, the thing you CHANGE is the...

why.en: C-M-S: Change, Measure, keep the Same.
why.zh: C-M-S：改变、测量、保持不变。

points.en: Change: the temperature of the water. Measure: the time for sugar to dissolve. Same: mass of sugar, volume of water.
points.zh: 改变：水温。测量：糖溶解的时间。不变：糖的质量、水的体积。

points.en: Evidence 证据 = results that show an idea is right: sugar dissolves faster in hot water.
points.zh: 证据 = 证明想法正确的结果：糖在热水里溶解得更快。

points.en: Priestley said: metals LOSE something to the air when they burn. Lavoisier said: metals GAIN something from the air.
points.zh: Priestley 说：金属燃烧时失去东西给空气。Lavoisier 说：金属从空气中得到东西。

points.en: Evidence: the mass goes UP after heating (2.4 g → 4.0 g). So Lavoisier is right. The metal gains oxygen.
points.zh: 证据：加热后质量增加（2.4 克 → 4.0 克）。所以 Lavoisier 对，金属得到了氧。

visual: Pick ONE side and give the evidence.

points.en: First column = what you change. Put units (g) in the headings.
points.zh: 第一列 = 你改变的东西。表头写单位 (g)。

main.en: metal | mass before (g) | mass after (g) | change in mass (g)
main.zh: 金属 | 加热前质量 (g) | 加热后质量 (g) | 质量变化 (g)

quick.q: The first column of a results table is...

why.en: First column = what you change.
why.zh: 第一列 = 你改变的东西。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in A8.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 A8 的关键词。

caption.en: A stadium wave: each person only stands up and sits down, but the wave travels all the way along!
caption.zh: 体育场人浪：每个人只是站起来再坐下，但“浪”一直往前走！

points.en: A wave is a disturbance that transfers ENERGY from one place to another.
points.zh: 波是一种扰动，把能量从一个地方传到另一个地方。

points.en: The wave moves along, but the stuff it travels through stays in the same place.
points.zh: 波向前走，但它经过的东西留在原地。

remember.zh: 波传递的是能量，不是物质。

points.en: In a transverse wave, the vibrations are PERPENDICULAR (at 90°) to the direction the wave travels.
points.zh: 横波的振动方向和传播方向垂直（成 90°）。

points.en: Watch the orange dot: it only goes up and down, while the wave moves sideways.
points.zh: 看橙色的点：它只是上下动，而波在横着走。

points.en: Examples: light, all electromagnetic waves, ripples on water.
points.zh: 例子：光、所有电磁波、水面的波纹。

quick.q: Water waves on a pond are...

why.en: The water moves up and down, at 90° to the way the wave travels.
why.zh: 水上下运动，和波传播方向成 90°。

points.en: Crest = the top. Trough = the bottom. The dashed line is the rest position.
points.zh: 波峰 = 最高点。波谷 = 最低点。虚线是平衡位置。

points.en: Amplitude = from the REST position to the crest.
points.zh: 振幅 = 从平衡位置到波峰。

points.en: Wavelength = from one crest to the next crest.
points.zh: 波长 = 从一个波峰到下一个波峰。

remember.en: Amplitude is NOT crest to trough. It is rest position to crest.
remember.zh: 振幅不是波峰到波谷，而是平衡位置到波峰。

points.en: In a longitudinal wave, the vibrations are PARALLEL to the direction the wave travels.
points.zh: 纵波的振动方向和传播方向平行。

points.en: Compression = particles squashed close together. Rarefaction = particles spread further apart.
points.zh: 密部 = 粒子挤得很近。疏部 = 粒子分得更开。

points.en: Sound is a longitudinal wave. Think of pushing and pulling a slinky.
points.zh: 声音是纵波。想一想推拉弹簧玩具。

quick.q: Sound waves are...

why.en: Particles vibrate parallel to the direction of travel.
why.zh: 粒子振动方向和传播方向平行。

main.en: frequency = number of waves ÷ time
main.zh: 频率 = 波的数量 ÷ 时间

points.en: Frequency = the number of complete waves passing a point each second.
points.zh: 频率 = 每秒通过某一点的完整波的数量。

points.en: It is measured in hertz (Hz). 1 Hz = one wave per second.
points.zh: 单位是赫兹 (Hz)。1 赫兹 = 每秒 1 个波。

items.en: Sound needs a medium: air, water or a solid.
items.zh: 声音需要介质：空气、水或固体。

items.en: Space is a vacuum: no particles, so no sound.
items.zh: 太空是真空：没有粒子，所以没有声音。

items.en: Light CAN travel through a vacuum.

points.en: Medium = a substance or material that a wave travels through.
points.zh: 介质 = 波传播时经过的物质。

points.en: Vacuum = a space containing no particles.
points.zh: 真空 = 没有任何粒子的空间。

points.en: Sound in air: about 340 m/s. In water: about 1500 m/s. Light: about 300,000 km/s!
points.zh: 声音在空气中约 340 米/秒，在水中约 1500 米/秒。光约 300,000 公里/秒！

quick.q: Can sound travel through a vacuum?

why.en: Sound needs particles (a medium). A vacuum has none.
why.zh: 声音需要粒子（介质），真空里没有。

points.en: Draw a long dashed line across the middle: the rest position.
points.zh: 在中间画一条长虚线：静止位置。

points.en: Draw 2 waves over it. Label a crest and a trough.
points.zh: 在上面画 2 个波，标出波峰和波谷。

points.en: Draw an arrow from the rest line UP to a crest: the amplitude. Draw an arrow from one crest to the next: the wavelength.
points.zh: 从静止线向上画一个箭头到波峰：振幅。从一个波峰画箭头到下一个波峰：波长。

prompt.en: Draw a transverse wave and label it.
prompt.zh: 画一个横波，并写上标签。

title.en: Draw it: a longitudinal wave (a slinky)

points.en: Draw a long slinky. Squash some coils close together and spread others apart.
points.zh: 画一条长弹簧。有些圈挤在一起，有些圈分得很开。

points.en: Label the squashed parts compression and the spread parts rarefaction.
points.zh: 挤在一起的地方标“密部”，分开的地方标“疏部”。

points.en: Draw a double arrow ↔ to show the push and pull, in the SAME direction the wave travels.
points.zh: 画一个双箭头 ↔ 表示推和拉，和波传播的方向相同。

prompt.en: Draw a slinky wave and label it.
prompt.zh: 画一个弹簧波，并写上标签。

main.zh: 波在其中传播的物质或材料。

canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B1 的关键词。

label.en: Low pitch: few waves each second
High pitch: many waves each second

points.en: Pitch = how high or low a sound seems. It depends on FREQUENCY only.
points.zh: 音调 = 声音听起来有多高或多低，只由频率决定。

points.en: More waves squeezed in = higher frequency = higher pitch.
points.zh: 波越密 = 频率越高 = 音调越高。

quick.q: A higher frequency gives a...

why.en: Pitch = frequency. Loudness = amplitude.
why.zh: 音调看频率，响度看振幅。

points.en: Loudness (volume) = how loud or quiet a sound seems. It depends on AMPLITUDE.
points.zh: 响度 = 声音听起来有多大或多小，由振幅决定。

points.en: Taller wave = bigger amplitude = louder sound. Sound level is measured in decibels (dB).
points.zh: 波越高 = 振幅越大 = 声音越大。声音大小的单位是分贝 (dB)。

remember.en: Pitch = frequency ONLY. Loudness = amplitude ONLY.
remember.zh: 音调只看频率，响度只看振幅。

quick.q: A bigger amplitude gives a...

why.en: Loudness = amplitude.
why.zh: 响度看振幅。

points.en: Move the amplitude slider: the wave gets taller and the sound gets louder.
points.zh: 拖动振幅滑块：波变高，声音变大。

points.en: Move the frequency slider: more waves and a higher pitch.
points.zh: 拖动频率滑块：波变多，音调变高。

items.zh: 人类能听到 20 到 20,000 赫兹

points.en: Audible range = the range of frequencies an animal can hear.
points.zh: 可听范围 = 动物能听到的频率范围。

points.en: Echo = a sound heard again after it reflects off a surface. Bats and dolphins use echolocation; ships use sonar.
points.zh: 回声 = 声音反射后再次被听到。蝙蝠和海豚用回声定位，船用声呐。

title.en: Draw it: loud and quiet, high and low
title.zh: 画一画：大声和小声，高音和低音

points.en: Draw 2 waves: a QUIET one (short) and a LOUD one (tall). Same number of waves in each.
points.zh: 画 2 个波：小声的（矮）和大声的（高），两个波的数量一样。

points.en: Draw 2 more: a LOW pitch (waves spread out) and a HIGH pitch (waves squeezed together). Same height in each.
points.zh: 再画 2 个：低音（波分得开）和高音（波挤在一起），高度一样。

points.en: Write under them: loudness = amplitude, pitch = frequency.
points.zh: 在下面写：响度 = 振幅，音调 = 频率。

prompt.en: Draw quiet, loud, low and high sound waves.
prompt.zh: 画出小声、大声、低音和高音的声波。

main.en: How high or low a sound seems. It depends on the frequency of the sound wave.
main.zh: 声音听起来有多高或多低，由声波的频率决定。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.

main.en: How loud or quiet a sound seems. It is related to the amplitude and intensity of the sound wave.
main.zh: 声音听起来有多大或多小，和声波的振幅和强度有关。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.

main.en: The range of sound frequencies that an animal can hear. For humans, this is approximately 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz.
main.zh: 动物能听到的声音频率范围。人类大约是20赫兹到20,000赫兹。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.

main.en: Sound with a frequency higher than 20,000 Hz, above the usual human hearing range.
main.zh: 频率高于20,000赫兹的声音，人耳听不到。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: Sound above 20,000 Hz is...

why.en: Ultra = beyond (above). Infra = below.
why.zh: ultra = 超过；infra = 低于。

main.en: Sound with a frequency lower than 20 Hz, below the usual human hearing range.
main.zh: 频率低于20赫兹的声音，人耳听不到。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.

main.en: A sound heard again after it has reflected off a surface.
main.zh: 声音碰到表面反射回来后再次被听到。

points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.zh: 利用反射的声波发现物体并判断它的位置或距离。

main.zh: 利用反射声波探测物体、测量距离的系统，常用在水下。

canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B2 的关键词。

points.en: The pinna collects sound. The eardrum vibrates. The ossicles (3 tiny bones) make the vibrations bigger.
points.zh: 耳廓收集声音，鼓膜振动，听小骨（3 块小骨头）把振动放大。

points.en: The cochlea turns vibrations into electrical signals. The auditory nerve carries them to the brain.
points.zh: 耳蜗把振动变成电信号，听神经把信号传到大脑。

points.en: Very loud sounds can damage the tiny hair cells in the cochlea forever.
points.zh: 很大的声音会永久损伤耳蜗里的毛细胞。

quick.q: Which comes FIRST when sound enters the ear?

why.en: Pinna → canal → eardrum → ossicles → cochlea → nerve.
why.zh: 耳廓 → 外耳道 → 鼓膜 → 听小骨 → 耳蜗 → 听神经。

title.en: Draw it: the path of sound

points.en: Draw a side view of an ear and the head.
points.zh: 画耳朵和头的侧面。

points.en: Draw arrows 1 to 6 to show sound going in: pinna, auditory canal, eardrum, ossicles, cochlea, auditory nerve, then the brain.
points.zh: 画箭头 1 到 6，表示声音进去的路线：耳廓、外耳道、鼓膜、听小骨、耳蜗、听神经，最后到大脑。

points.en: Next to each part, write one word for its job: collects, carries, vibrates, makes bigger, makes signals, carries to the brain.
points.zh: 在每个部分旁边写一个词说明它的作用：收集、传送、振动、放大、变成信号、送到大脑。

prompt.en: Draw the ear and number the path of sound.
prompt.zh: 画耳朵，给声音的路线编号。

main.zh: 内耳里螺旋形的结构，把振动变成电信号。

why.zh: 光不能穿过砖墙。

main.zh: 自己会发光的物体。

points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: The Moon is...

why.en: It reflects sunlight. It does not make its own light.
why.zh: 它反射太阳光，自己不发光。

main.en: A straight line used to show the direction in which light travels.
main.zh: 表示光传播方向的直线。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: To allow something, such as light, to pass through a material.
main.zh: 让光等东西穿过材料。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: To take in energy, such as light, rather than reflecting or transmitting it.
main.zh: 把光等能量吸进去，而不是反射或透射。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in B4.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B4 的关键词。

main.en: A flat mirror with a smooth, reflective surface.
main.zh: 表面平滑、能反射的平的镜子。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: When an image appears reversed from left to right, as in a plane mirror.
main.zh: 像左右反过来，就像在平面镜里一样。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The change in direction of light when it bounces off a surface.
main.zh: 光碰到表面弹回来时方向的改变。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The ray of light travelling towards a surface before reflection or refraction.
main.zh: 反射或折射之前射向表面的光线。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The ray of light that bounces off a surface.
main.zh: 从表面弹回来的光线。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The angle between the incident ray and the normal.
main.zh: 入射光线和法线之间的角。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: Angle of incidence = 40°. Angle of reflection = ?

why.en: They are always equal.
why.zh: 它们总是相等。

main.en: The angle between the reflected ray and the normal.
main.zh: 反射光线和法线之间的角。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: An imaginary line drawn at 90° to a surface at the point where a ray hits it.
main.zh: 在光线射到的点上，与表面成90°的假想线。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: The normal is at ___ to the surface.

why.en: Normal = a line at 90°.
why.zh: 法线和表面成 90°。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in B5.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B5 的关键词。

main.en: The change in direction of light when it passes between different materials because its speed changes.
main.zh: 光从一种材料进入另一种材料时，因为速度改变而方向改变。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: Refraction happens because light changes...

why.en: Changing speed between materials makes light change direction.
why.zh: 在不同材料之间速度改变，光就改变方向。

points.en: Light travels at different speeds in different materials: fastest in air, slower in water, slower again in glass.
points.zh: 光在不同材料里速度不同：在空气中最快，在水中慢一些，在玻璃中更慢。

points.en: When light goes from one material into another, its speed changes, so its direction changes. That is refraction.
points.zh: 光从一种材料进入另一种材料时，速度改变，方向也改变。这就是折射。

points.en: That is why a straw in a glass of water looks bent.
points.zh: 所以水杯里的吸管看起来是弯的。

remember.zh: 速度变 → 方向变 = 折射。

quick.q: A straw in water looks bent because of...

why.en: Light changes speed as it leaves the water, so it bends.
why.zh: 光离开水时速度改变，所以会弯折。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in B6.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B6 的关键词。

main.en: A transparent object, usually made of glass or plastic, that can refract and disperse light.
main.zh: 透明物体，通常是玻璃或塑料做的，能折射和分散光。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The separation of white light into its different colours.
main.zh: 白光分成不同颜色。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: A range of different colours or wavelengths, such as the visible spectrum.
main.zh: 一系列不同的颜色或波长，比如可见光谱。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: A colour of light that can be combined with other primary colours to produce a range of colours. For light, these are red, green and blue.
main.zh: 可以和其他原色混合出很多颜色的光的颜色。光的三原色：红、绿、蓝。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: The primary colours of LIGHT are red, green and...

why.en: Light: red, green, blue. (Paint is different.)
why.zh: 光的三原色：红、绿、蓝。（颜料不一样。）

main.en: A colour produced by mixing two primary colours of light. These are cyan, magenta and yellow.
main.zh: 两种原色光混合产生的颜色：青、品红、黄。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: Red light + blue light = ?

why.en: Red + blue = magenta. Green + blue = cyan.
why.zh: 红 + 蓝 = 品红；绿 + 蓝 = 青。

points.en: White light is a mix of colours. A prism splits it: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet.
points.zh: 白光是很多颜色混在一起的。棱镜把它分开：红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫。

points.en: Remember the order with the name: ROY G BIV.
points.zh: 用名字 ROY G BIV 记住顺序。

points.en: Red + green = yellow. Red + blue = magenta. Green + blue = cyan.
points.zh: 红 + 绿 = 黄；红 + 蓝 = 品红；绿 + 蓝 = 青。

points.en: Red + green + blue = white light.
points.zh: 红 + 绿 + 蓝 = 白光。

points.en: Careful: this is for LIGHT. Paint mixes differently.
points.zh: 注意：这是光的混合，颜料不一样。

quick.q: Red light + green light + blue light = ?

why.en: All three primary colours of light make white.
why.zh: 三种原色光加起来是白光。

points.en: Absorb means take in. Reflect means bounce back.
points.zh: absorb（吸收）= 吸进去；reflect（反射）= 弹回来。

points.en: A red apple REFLECTS red light into your eyes and ABSORBS all the other colours.
points.zh: 红苹果把红光反射进你的眼睛，把其他颜色都吸收了。

points.en: White objects reflect ALL colours. Black objects absorb ALL colours.
points.zh: 白色物体反射所有颜色；黑色物体吸收所有颜色。

quick.q: A black T-shirt...

why.en: No light is reflected, so it looks black.
why.zh: 没有光被反射，所以看起来是黑的。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in B7.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B7 的关键词。

main.en: A transverse wave that can travel through a vacuum without needing a medium.
main.zh: 一种横波，不需要介质，能在真空中传播。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The complete range of electromagnetic waves, arranged according to their wavelength or frequency.
main.zh: 按波长或频率排列的全部电磁波。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: A low-frequency electromagnetic wave used for radio and television communication.
main.zh: 低频电磁波，用于广播和电视通信。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: Which has the LOWER frequency?

why.en: Radio is at the low-frequency end. Gamma is at the high end.
why.zh: 无线电波在低频端，伽马射线在高频端。

main.en: An electromagnetic wave used in cooking, radar and satellite communication.
main.zh: 用于烹饪、雷达和卫星通信的电磁波。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: Electromagnetic radiation associated with heat, used in thermal imaging and remote controls.
main.zh: 和热有关的电磁辐射，用于热成像和遥控器。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: The part of the electromagnetic spectrum that can be detected by the human eye.
main.zh: 人眼能看到的那部分电磁波谱。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: Electromagnetic radiation with a higher frequency than visible light, which can cause sunburn and damage skin cells.
main.zh: 频率比可见光高的电磁辐射，会晒伤皮肤、损伤皮肤细胞。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

quick.q: UV can cause...

why.en: UV damages skin cells.
why.zh: 紫外线会伤害皮肤细胞。

main.en: High-frequency electromagnetic radiation that can pass through soft tissue and is used to produce medical images.
main.zh: 高频电磁辐射，能穿过软组织，用来拍医学影像。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: Very high-frequency electromagnetic radiation that can be produced by radioactive materials and used in cancer treatment.
main.zh: 频率非常高的电磁辐射，可由放射性物质产生，用于治疗癌症。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

main.en: Radiation with enough energy to remove electrons from atoms, potentially damaging cells and DNA.
main.zh: 能量足以把电子从原子中打出来的辐射，可能损伤细胞和DNA。

points.en: This is your school's definition. Learn it word for word.
points.zh: 这是学校的定义，要一字不差地记住。

title.en: The order of the EM spectrum

points.en: From LOW frequency (long wavelength) to HIGH frequency (short wavelength): radio, microwave, infrared, visible light, ultraviolet, X-ray, gamma.
points.zh: 从低频（波长长）到高频（波长短）：无线电波、微波、红外线、可见光、紫外线、X 射线、伽马射线。

points.en: Memory trick: Rabbits Mate In Very Unusual eXpensive Gardens (R, M, I, V, U, X, G).
points.zh: 记忆口诀：Rabbits Mate In Very Unusual eXpensive Gardens（R、M、I、V、U、X、G）。

points.en: The higher the frequency, the more energy. UV, X-rays and gamma rays are ionising radiation: they can damage cells.
points.zh: 频率越高，能量越大。紫外线、X 射线和伽马射线是电离辐射，会伤害细胞。

remember.en: Low frequency, long wavelength → high frequency, short wavelength.
remember.zh: 低频、长波长 → 高频、短波长。

quick.q: Which comes straight AFTER visible light (higher frequency)?

why.en: Order: ... infrared, visible, ULTRAVIOLET, X-ray, gamma.
why.zh: 顺序：……红外线、可见光、紫外线、X 射线、伽马射线。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in B8.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 B8 的关键词。
